name: ClickUp
summary: You can connect ClickUp using either OAuth (for apps used by others) or a personal API token (for your own/testing use). OAuth lets users securely authorize your integration with their Workspace. Creating an OAuth app is restricted to Workspace owners/admins.
decision: If you're using Composio-managed OAuth, you can use it directly. Otherwise, to set up your own ClickUp OAuth app, you must log in as a Workspace owner/admin, create an app in ClickUp settings under Apps, and set your integration's redirect URL. After getting your client ID and secret, you must implement the OAuth Authorization Code flow: direct users to the ClickUp authorization URL, capture the code, and exchange it for an access token using the access token endpoint.

prerequisites.title: ClickUp Workspace owner or admin access
prerequisites.body: Only owners/admins can create OAuth apps in ClickUp.

prerequisites.title: A redirect URL for your integration
prerequisites.body: You need a redirect URL for your app—this may come from your integration platform or your service.

steps.title: Log in to ClickUp as Workspace owner or admin
steps.body: Go to your ClickUp Workspace. Only owners or admins can register OAuth apps.

steps.title: Open Apps settings
steps.body: Click your avatar, select 'Settings', then go to 'Apps'.

steps.title: Create a new OAuth app
steps.body: Click 'Create new app', provide a name, and enter your integration's redirect URL.

steps.title: Obtain Client ID and Secret
steps.body: After creation, save the client_id and secret ClickUp provides.

steps.title: Set up authorization flow
steps.body: Send users to https://app.clickup.com/api?client_id={client_id}&redirect_uri={redirect_uri} so they can approve access.

steps.title: Handle authorization code
steps.body: Users, after approving, are redirected to your redirect URL with a code parameter.

steps.title: Exchange code for access token
steps.body: POST to https://api.clickup.com/api/v2/oauth/token with client_id, client_secret, and code to obtain an access token.

steps.title: Authorize API requests
steps.body: For each API call, include the header Authorization: Bearer {access_token}.

human_actions.title: Log in to ClickUp as an owner/admin
human_actions.body: You must sign in as an owner or admin to create your OAuth app.

human_actions.title: Create the app in ClickUp settings
Enter the redirect URL
human_actions.body: Manually copy your integration's redirect URL into the ClickUp app form.

human_actions.title: Authorize the app as a user
human_actions.body: End users must grant access to their Workspace via the authorization URL.
